facets.description: TestMode3_Create never waits for or verifies the async Legacy.Create call.
TestMode3_Delete never waits for or verifies the async Legacy.Delete call.
TestMode3_DeleteCollection never waits for or verifies the async Legacy.DeleteCollection call.
TestMode3_Update never waits for or verifies async Legacy.Update; missing calls or legacy failures leave it green.
The DeleteCollection legacy goroutine incorrectly calls recordStorageDuration, and the test does not catch this metric bug.
